a: Postdoc posts on STFC Consolidated Grant 'Particle Theory at the Higgs Centre'
e: Two postdocs in lattice field theory: precision lattice QCD for (semi-)leptonic decays with QED corrections (Portelli), and multi-hadron scattering, decay amplitudes and long-distance matrix elements (Hansen). Open to PhDs in theoretical particle physics.
n: University of Edinburgh Higgs Centre: Two Lattice QCD Postdoctoral Research Associates
unv: The INSPIRE listing gives no link to the university's own ad; salary not stated.
